description: Give realtime parser forms direct, non-nonsensical action responses instead of leaking generic object assumptions

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-COMMAND ()
	 <COND (<FSET? ,PRSO ,ACTORBIT>
		<TELL "The " D ,PRSO " pays no attention." CR>)
	       (T
		<TELL "You cannot talk to that!" CR>)>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-COMMAND-SELF ()
	 <TELL "You are already in command of yourself." CR>>

<ROUTINE V-COMMAND ()
	 <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME>
		<TELL "You are already in command of yourself." CR>)
	       (<FSET? ,PRSO ,ACTORBIT>
		<TELL "The " D ,PRSO " pays no attention." CR>)
	       (T
		<TELL "You can't command the " D ,PRSO "." CR>)>>

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-TALK-UNSPECIFIED ()
	 <TELL "Whom do you want to talk to?" CR>>

<ROUTINE PRINT-SPOKEN-INPUT ("AUX" PTR COUNT BUF)
	 <SET PTR ,P-SPOKEN-PTR>
	 <SET COUNT ,P-SPOKEN-COUNT>
	 <TELL "You say \"">
	 <REPEAT ()
		 <COND (<ZERO? .COUNT> <RETURN>)>
		 <SET BUF <* .PTR 2>>
		 <WORD-PRINT <GETB <REST ,P-LEXV .BUF> 2>
			     <GETB <REST ,P-LEXV .BUF> 3>>
		 <SET COUNT <- .COUNT 1>>
		 <COND (<G? .COUNT 0> <TELL " ">)>
		 <SET PTR <+ .PTR ,P-LEXELEN>>>
	 <TELL ".\"" CR>
	 <SETG P-SPOKEN-PTR 0>
	 <SETG P-SPOKEN-COUNT 0>
	 <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-HELP ()
	 <TELL "Try direct commands such as LOOK, INVENTORY, TAKE, OPEN, TALK TO, SAY, or YELL AT. Separate sequential actions with a comma or THEN." CR>>

<ROUTINE V-MOO () <TELL "Moooo." CR>>
<ROUTINE V-BARK () <TELL "Woof!" CR>>

<ROUTINE V-YELL () <TELL "Aaaarrrrgggghhhh!" CR>>

<ROUTINE V-YELL-AT ()
	 <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME>
		<TELL "You yell at yourself. You hear yourself perfectly well." CR>)
	       (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ZORK-INTERFACE>
		<TELL "You yell at Zork. At your service!" CR>)
	       (T
		<TELL "You yell at the " D ,PRSO ". It does not respond." CR>)>>

<ROUTINE V-ZORK () <TELL "At your service!" CR>>
